summary: Full E2E of Home Easy product line (backend + frontend + admin). 9/9 pytest cases pass. Quote math matches spec exactly (gross 885 → discount 88.5 → +addon 35 → SST 66.52 → total 898.02). Wizard deep-link from calculator skips Step 0 to owner step. Skip-payment issues HO-prefixed 1-year policy. PolicyCard renders with data-variant='ocean' (deep blue) for home category. Admin rate-table editor opens with all 8 home-* testids and persists meta.base_rate_per_100k change.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/quotes.py is now ~700 lines (travel + motor + pa + health + home + list/get). Strongly recommend splitting per-product into routers/quotes_health.py, quotes_home.py, quotes_motor.py etc — file size threshold breached.

HomeQuoteInput rejects building_sum_insured > b_max with HTTP 400 BUT also gt=0 in Field — both are fine; just note that the Field ge=0 on contents allows 0 which then bypasses the c_min bound check (the `if body.contents_sum_insured and ...` guard). Acceptable as 0-contents is valid, but document.
PATCH /api/products/{id} returns 200 on meta replace; consider deep-merge for partial meta updates so an admin editing only `base_rate_per_100k` doesn't have to PATCH the entire meta blob.

HomeCoverageCalculator.jsx: the price big number uses `text-[72px]` with `font-display`. The same heading section also uses `font-display`, so generic `.font-display` selectors are ambiguous. (Minor — testers can scope via the dark price card.) Suggest adding `data-testid="home-calc-total"` to the big total for testability.
Console: 2 x 404 'Failed to load resource' on /home-quote step navigation (likely a missing image or favicon) — non-blocking but worth investigating in network tab.
Bounds messages '`Building sum insured must be between 50000 and 2000000`' use raw integer formatting; consider currency formatter (RM 50,000) for UX parity with rest of site.
seed_data_creation: Tests issue real quotes & policies for the demo customer (TEST_HomeUser cardholder). Multiple HO- policies are visible in /policies as expected — no teardown required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home Easy is fully wired end-to-end. Backend formula validated: building = (b_sum/100k) × base_rate × plan.building_mult × ptype.multiplier; contents = (c_sum/100k) × contents_rate × plan.contents_mult; gross → −online_discount% → +addons → +rules_delta → +SST → total. Validations enforced: accept_privacy=true, building/contents min/max bounds, plan_key/property_type literal validation. Policy issuance: HO-YYMMDD-XXXXX, category='home', exact 1y term. Frontend testids confirmed: home-insurance-page, home-buy-now-btn, home-coverage-calculator, home-benefit-0..4, home-plan-basic|enhanced|premier, home-calc-plan-{key}, home-calc-ptype-{key}, home-calc-cta, home-skip-payment-btn. Admin testids: admin-product-home, home-plan-row-{basic,enhanced,premier}, home-ptype-row-landed, home-rate-building, home-rate-contents, home-online-pct, home-tax-pct.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects. Calculator initial test mistakenly read `.font-display` first match (a heading) instead of the price; corrected with scoped selector and confirmed price updates 860.22 → 1,727.73 on plan=premier+property=commercial. PolicyCard ocean variant verified via data-variant='ocean' attribute count (5 home cards on /policies).
